decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core seasonal offer and costs little to keep, so the option stays open even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.

The motif platform was an accessory to the electronic music box line, which was withdrawn in 2019, so its option value has largely vanished and its resources are better redeployed to the core business.
With the music box system it complemented already abandoned and no visibility since 2018, the Christmas platform reveals little remaining upside to justify keeping it.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core craft competencies and has steady gift appeal at minimal holding cost, so keeping it remains worthwhile.
